_comment: Who may sign in with Google and what they may see. admins: the owner and team members; they see the whole dashboard (scorecard, Mapping, admin routes, invoice approvals) and can open any rep's view. Sales reps sign in with the signInEmail on their entry in config/sales-reps.json and only ever see their own data at /me. Everyone else is refused at sign-in. Edit the admin list here, no restart needed; matching ignores upper/lower case.
_comment2: Admins who may merge event history from another copy of the dashboard (POST /api/admin/import-history) and use the weekly-report admin route.
